STATEMENT OF WORK (SYNTHETIC — CORE-200 TEST FIXTURE — DISTRACTOR)
Solicitation No.: SYN-G-0007
Title: IT Service Desk Tier-1 Help Desk Support

1. SCOPE
The Contractor shall staff a Tier-1 IT help desk providing password
resets, account provisioning, and basic troubleshooting for office
productivity software across the installation's unclassified network.

2. REQUIREMENTS
2.1 Staff the help desk during core business hours.
2.2 Log and triage all incoming tickets in the government-furnished
    ticketing system.
2.3 Escalate Tier-2/3 issues to the network operations center.

3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE
Administrative building, notional installation.
